name: Ghana
notes: Seed pass (national level, English only). Register: the 16 regions and the 260 Metropolitan, Municipal and District Assemblies (MMDAs), the local tier, with OCHA P-codes (GH01-GH16, GH0101-GH1609). No regional or local sweep. Map: OCHA/HDX COD-AB Ghana (Survey and Mapping Division of Ghana), CC BY-IGO, read from the unmodified copy at data.fieldmaps.io because HDX download links answer scripts with a bot challenge (not bypassed).
